primary_landing.label: Today
primary_landing.purpose: All-project command center showing what matters today across projects, meetings, action items, source-linked changes, and the optional Daily Brief.

top_level_navigation.label: Today
top_level_navigation.purpose: Primary landing dashboard for important today, what changed, meetings, action items, portfolio signals, and optional executive Daily Brief.

secondary_navigation.label: Overview
secondary_navigation.purpose: High-level project or all-project dashboard with important today, what changed, action items, cost/time, field, document/correspondence, and closeout/billing signals.

secondary_navigation.label: Meetings
secondary_navigation.purpose: Meeting analytics and prep context using calendar, correspondence, files, Procore context, and action items.

secondary_navigation.label: Field Operations
secondary_navigation.purpose: Startup, closeout, daily log, observations, punch-list, inspection, quality/safety, and field attention data.

secondary_navigation.label: Cost & Time
secondary_navigation.purpose: Cost exposure, change management, billing/cash/retention, schedule, procurement, and cost/time-impacting RFI/submittal/design-decision signals.

top_level_navigation.label: My Items
top_level_navigation.purpose: User-specific dashboard for action items, meetings, correspondence, OneDrive files, followed projects, and review-required items.

support_navigation.label: Admin / Data Confidence
support_navigation.purpose: Supporting trust/governance layer for source health, workflow health, evidence, guardrails, retrieval quality, permissions, and data completeness.

support_navigation.label: Settings
support_navigation.purpose: User preferences, followed projects, Daily Brief setup, auth reconnect/revoke, project keyword preferences, and admin-only configuration.

disabled_navigation.label: Chat
disabled_navigation.reason: Future feature only. No active chat page, chat widget, streaming endpoint, or user-accessible chat route in this implementation.
